description: Affiliation string to ROR ID — Normalize messy author affiliation strings to research organizations: affiliation= a raw string such as Dept of Physics, Stanford Univ., Palo Alto CA (up to 10 separated by ||). Uses ROR's affiliation matcher: status MATCHED (confidence HIGH, with the full organization record: ROR ID, name, types, location, website, external IDs) or CANDIDATES (top 3 with scores for review) or NO_MATCH. Ideal for cleaning author metadata, grant and publication data. Source: ROR (ror.org, CC0 public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

affiliation.description: e.g. Stanford Univ. Department of Physics Palo Alto CA

name: research_affiliation_match
